title: The Hoard in the Hollow
text: A dead king's gold spills across the floor of a hollow tree, coins and crowns and cups, more than any one House could carry. The king himself sits among it, nothing left of him but a grin. You agree to share it. Each House decides, alone in the dark, whether it means to.

options.label: Share it fairly, as you swore you would.

outcomes.text: Every House kept its word. The gold is shared, and so is a little trust, which is rarer.
Your share is gone when you reach for it. Someone else did not keep their word, and the dead king grins on.

options.label: Take more than your share. The dead king will hardly miss it.

outcomes.text: Nobody else thought of it. Your packs are heavy all the way home, and so is your conscience, for a little while.
Others had the same idea. Knives come out over the coins before anyone thinks better of it, and the dead king grins at all of you.
